ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try this as a convenient Alexa display alongside my Fire TV devices, with video calling as an added use.
ItemID: 2; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Home monitoring interests me, but I just added a Blink camera and don't need another camera this time.
ItemID: 3; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try controlling a lamp through Alexa as a useful addition to my connected home setup.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but I'd choose the Echo Show 8 for its screen rather than add both devices now.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display appeals to me, but I'd prefer the larger Show 8 offered on this page.
ItemID: 6; Title: JSAUX USB-C to USB A Cable 3.1A Fast Charging [2-Pack 6.6ft], USB Type C Charger Cord Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S10 S9 S8 S20 Plus A51 A12 A11, Note 10 9 8, PS5 Controller USB C Charger-Green; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don't have a specific USB-C charging need right now.
ItemID: 7; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage could be useful for my new camcorder, but I'd check its card requirements before choosing this bundle.
ItemID: 8; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on television and cameras, and I don't currently need a tablet.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Alexa is centered on home entertainment; I don't have a current need for it in the car.
ItemID: 10; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick offers little benefit right now.
